title: Speechius
claim: Product Hunt: Speechius — The teleprompter that actually listens
why_good: A teleprompter that follows your voice and scrolls as you speak — a real, specific improvement for creators and speakers.
value: Teachers filming their own lessons, single-operator sellers, in-house trainers. Subscription.
risk: Too thin a layer — swallowed by the editing software people already open next.
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score

zh.claim: Product Hunt: Speechius —— 真正会听的提词器。
zh.why_good: 一个跟着你的声音滚动的提词器——对创作者和演讲者是真实、具体的改进。
zh.value: 自己录课的老师、一个人拍货的店主、做内训的人；订阅。
zh.risk: 层太薄，被人们紧接着打开的剪辑软件顺手包掉。
zh.hook: 自己拍口播的人——录课的老师、自己拍产品视频的小店主——时间主要不是花在讲错，而是提词器按秒往下滚：你一停下想词，字就跑没了，整条重录。
zh.does: 提词器跟着你的声音走：你念到哪它滚到哪，你停它也停，你跳一句它跟着跳。
zh.gap: 市面上的提词器要么定速滚动，要么要一只手按遥控。真正跟住一个活人说话，要的是带口音的实时语音对齐——今年才便宜到可以白送。
zh.counter: 这是一个功能不是一家公司：BIGVU、PromptSmart 已经有语音跟随，手机厂商或剪辑软件补上也就一个版本的事。
zh.differentiator: 别卖提词器，卖「这条能不能用」：一停止录制就标出你念漏的句子和吃字的那几秒，并给一句留不留的判断。冷启动：中文=小红书「口播 提词器」「录课 卡壳」标签；英文=r/NewTubers 的 I re-record every take 帖。

hook: People who film their own talking-head video — a teacher recording a lesson, a shop owner recording a product clip — lose most of their time not to fluffing a line but to the teleprompter scrolling on a timer: you pause to find the word, the text runs away, and you re-shoot the whole take.
does: A teleprompter that follows your voice instead of a clock: it scrolls to where you actually are, stops when you stop, and skips ahead when you skip a sentence.
gap: Every teleprompter on the market either scrolls at a fixed rate or needs a hand on a remote. Following a real speaker in real time needs accented streaming speech alignment, which only became cheap enough to give away this year.
counter: This is a feature, not a company — BIGVU and PromptSmart already have voice tracking, and a phone maker or an editing suite absorbs it in one release.
differentiator: Stop selling the prompter and sell 'is this take usable': the moment you stop recording, mark the sentences you dropped and the seconds you swallowed words, and say whether to keep it. Cold start (Chinese): 小红书 「口播 提词器」「录课 卡壳」 tags; (English): the 'I re-record every take' threads in r/NewTubers.
consumer_angle: Anyone filming themselves alone with no crew; the deliverable is a take they do not have to shoot again.
